newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Japanese fishing boat detained for penetrating Taiwan's territorial waters.
Vice-President Lien Chan meets prominent Irish politicians.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Lien Chan arrives in Ireland for academic visit.
Government to sell state shares to public at discount. LIBERTY TIMES - Lien Chan leaves Rome for Ireland, which has no diplomatic ties with Taiwan.
Communist China puts pressure on four Central American nations that befriend Taiwan.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan share prices break 7,200-point to reach seven-year high.
Council for Economic Planning and Development decides to release government-owned shares to public, citizens aged 20 and above eligible to buy.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - State-run Chinese Petroleum may release 30 percent of shares in July.
Formosa Plastics' holding company to withdraw from Hong Kong.
